name: Protective Gale
notes:
One cast applies the buff to everyone in range. Evasion means dodge chance. The buff's Evasion amount, duration, range, mana cost and cooldown are left for tuning.

In game (hwp_rog_protective_gale, tested): the rogue and teammates within 96 get Evasion for 6 s, the effect following each player. All numbers assumed (the design left them for tuning): Evasion 15/18/21/24/30%, 6 s, radius 96, mana 40-60, cooldown 20 s. Teammates are untested (needs a second player).
summary: Grant yourself and nearby teammates increased Evasion for a duration. The buff stays with each player as they move.
